You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Le Gardien du Phare",
  "slug": "le-gardien-du-phare",
  "lang": "fr",
  "gameType": "stage-clear",
  "loop": "Faites glisser le doigt autour de la tour pour tourner le faisceau et éclairer chaque bateau assez longtemps pour qu'il rentre au port. Guidez tous les bateaux de la nuit pour gagner ; un bateau qui touche les rochers fait perdre la nuit.",
  "input": "drag-follow",
  "style": "paper-cut"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `drag-follow`

# Drag follow

The player presses on a piece and it trails the pointer until release. Good for steering, sorting and placing.

- Register `pointerdown`, `pointermove` and `pointerup` on the canvas and capture the pointer on press. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Convert client coordinates to canvas coordinates with `getBoundingClientRect()` and the device pixel ratio.
- Ease towards the target instead of snapping, so small jitters do not shake the piece.

```js
let held = null;
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  held = pieceAt(toCanvas(event));
  if (held) canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
  if (held) held.target = toCanvas(event);
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", () => {
  held = null;
});
```

Drop the piece on `pointercancel` as well, so a system gesture never leaves it stuck to the finger.

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `paper-cut`

# Paper cut

Everything looks cut from coloured card and stacked in layers.

## Palette

| role       | colour    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| background | `#f4ecd8` |
| layer      | `#e07a5f` |
| accent     | `#3d405b` |
| highlight  | `#81b29a` |

## Primitives

- Filled paths with slightly irregular edges: jitter each vertex by one or two pixels, seeded once so it does not flicker.
- One soft shadow per layer: `shadowBlur` around 6 and a small downward offset.
- Rounded rectangles and circles for pieces; stacked copies offset by a few pixels suggest depth.
- Text in a heavy system sans-serif, drawn on a card-shaped plate.

## Avoid

- Gradients, glows and outlines thicker than two pixels.
- Pure black; use the accent colour for the darkest tone.
- Photographic textures or anything loaded from a file.

### Card `stage-clear`

# Stage clear

The player meets a stated goal to clear each stage. Clearing the last stage wins; failing a stage loses.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `optional`    |
| level                | `required`    |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `win, lose`   |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above: a `level` on entering each stage and an `end` when the play-through finishes. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden` in the row above. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- Use only `win` or `lose` as the `end` reason. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Stages

Number stages from 1 and step by one. Show the goal on screen when each stage opens ("Light 5 lamps"). Make stage 1 easy enough to clear on the first try.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let stage = 0;
function enterStage(next) {
  stage = next;
  buildStage(stage);
  CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage });
}
function onGoalMet() {
  if (stage === STAGES.length) CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win" });
  else enterStage(stage + 1);
}
function onStageFailed() {
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose" });
}
```

Give the player a few seconds of grace at the start of each stage before any threat can finish it.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
I'll build the full game now.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Le Gardien du Phare</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #f4ecd8;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100dvh;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ---- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};

window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  // ---- Palette ----
  const COLORS = {
    bg: "#f4ecd8",
    layer: "#e07a5f",
    accent: "#3d405b",
    highlight: "#81b29a"
  };

  // ---- Sizing ----
  let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
  function resize() {
    DPR = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR);
    canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();

  // ---- Seeded jitter for paper-cut edges ----
  function mulberry32(a) {
    return function() {
      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  const rng = mulberry32(1337);
  function jitter(amount) { return (rng() - 0.5) * 2 * amount; }

  // Precompute jittered polygon points once per shape id, cached
  const jitterCache = {};
  function jitteredPoly(id, points, amt) {
    if (jitterCache[id]) return jitterCache[id];
    const out = points.map(p => [p[0] + jitter(amt), p[1] + jitter(amt)]);
    jitterCache[id] = out;
    return out;
  }

  function drawPaperShadow(fn) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.35)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    fn();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function roundRectPath(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  // ---- Game state ----
  const STAGES = [
    { goal: 1, boats: 1, speed: 0.55, rockDanger: 1 },
    { goal: 2, boats: 2, speed: 0.65, rockDanger: 1 },
    { goal: 3, boats: 3, speed: 0.75, rockDanger: 1.2 },
    { goal: 4, boats: 4, speed: 0.85, rockDanger: 1.3 },
    { goal: 5, boats: 5, speed: 0.95, rockDanger: 1.5 }
  ];

  let stage = 0;
  let screenState = "title"; // title, grace, playing, stagewin, win, lose
  let paused = false;
  let booted = false;
  let started = false;

  let beamAngle = 0; // radians
  let targetAngle = 0;
  let center = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  let towerRadius = 60;
  let rocksAngle = []; // list of rock angle ranges (rad)
  let boats = [];
  let savedCount = 0;
  let goalCount = 1;
  let graceTimer = 0;
  let stageMessage = "";
  let stageMessageTimer = 0;
  let elapsed = 0;

  function backToTitle() {
    screenState = "title";
    started = false;
    stage = 0;
    savedCount = 0;
  }

  function angleDiff(a, b) {
    let d = (a - b) % (Math.PI * 2);
    if (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
    if (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
    return d;
  }

  function buildStage(n) {
    const cfg = STAGES[n - 1];
    goalCount = cfg.goal;
    savedCount = 0;
    boats = [];
    // rocks: 2-3 fixed danger arcs around the tower
    rocksAngle = [];
    const rockCount = 2 + (n > 2 ? 1 : 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < rockCount; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 / rockCount) * i + jitter(0.3);
      rocksAngle.push({ center: a, width: 0.35 * cfg.rockDanger });
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < cfg.boats; i++) {
      spawnBoat(cfg.speed, i * 1.3);
    }
    stageMessage = "Phare " + n + " : guidez " + cfg.goal + " bateau" + (cfg.goal > 1 ? "x" : "") + " au port";
    stageMessageTimer = 3.5;
    graceTimer = 3.0; // grace period before rocks can sink boats
    screenState = "grace";
    elapsed = 0;
    CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: n });
  }

  function spawnBoat(speed, delayOffset) {
    const startAngle = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
    const dir = rng() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
    boats.push({
      angle: startAngle,
      dist: 1.0, // 1 = far, 0 = at port (center ring)
      speed: speed * (0.85 + rng() * 0.3),
      dir,
      lit: 0, // how long continuously lit
      needLit: 1.6, // seconds of light needed to guide safely inward
      saved: false,
      sunk: false,
      wobble: rng() * 10,
      delay: delayOffset
    });
  }

  function enterStage(next) {
    stage = next;
    buildStage(stage);
  }

  function onGoalMet() {
    if (stage === STAGES.length) {
      screenState = "win";
      CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win" });
    } else {
      screenState = "stagewin";
      stageMessageTimer = 1.8;
    }
  }

  function onStageFailed() {
    screenState = "lose";
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose" });
  }

  // ---- Input: drag to rotate beam ----
  function toCanvas(evt) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: (evt.clientX - rect.left),
      y: (evt.clientY - rect.top)
    };
  }

  let held = false;

  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
    const p = toCanvas(event);
    if (screenState === "title") {
      startGame();
      return;
    }
    if (screenState === "stagewin" || screenState === "win" || screenState === "lose") {
      return;
    }
    held = true;
    canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    updateTargetFromPoint(p);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
    if (!held) return;
    updateTargetFromPoint(toCanvas(event));
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", () => { held = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", () => { held = false; });

  function updateTargetFromPoint(p) {
    const dx = p.x - center.x;
    const dy = p.y - center.y;
    targetAngle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
  }

  function startGame() {
    started = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    enterStage(1);
  }

  // ---- Update ----
  function update(dt) {
    if (paused) return;
    center.x = W / 2;
    center.y = H / 2;

    if (screenState === "title" || screenState === "win" || screenState === "lose") {
      // idle animation of the beam
      targetAngle += dt * 0.15;
    }

    // ease beam angle towards target
    let diff = angleDiff(targetAngle, beamAngle);
    beamAngle += diff * Math.min(1, dt * 6);

    if (stageMessageTimer > 0) stageMessageTimer -= dt;

    if (screenState === "grace") {
      graceTimer -= dt;
      updateBoats(dt, false);
      if (graceTimer <= 0) screenState = "playing";
      return;
    }

    if (screenState === "playing") {
      elapsed += dt;
      updateBoats(dt, true);
    }

    if (screenState === "stagewin") {
      if (stageMessageTimer <= 0) {
        enterStage(stage + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  const beamHalfWidth = 0.24; // radians of beam cone

  function isLit(boat) {
    const d = Math.abs(angleDiff(beamAngle, boat.angle));
    return d < beamHalfWidth;
  }

  function inRockZone(angle) {
    for (const r of rocksAngle) {
      const d = Math.abs(angleDiff(angle, r.center));
      if (d < r.width) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function updateBoats(dt, dangerActive) {
    for (const boat of boats) {
      if (boat.saved || boat.sunk) continue;
      boat.wobble += dt * 3;

      if (isLit(boat)) {
        boat.lit += dt;
      } else {
        boat.lit = Math.max(0, boat.lit - dt * 0.5);
      }

      // boat drifts slowly around the tower
      boat.angle += boat.dir * dt * 0.12;

      // move inward only if sufficiently lit
      if (boat.lit >= boat.needLit) {
        boat.dist -= dt * boat.speed * 0.18;
      } else {
        // drifts outward slowly if neglected too long
        boat.dist += dt * 0.02;
        if (boat.dist > 1.15) boat.dist = 1.15;
      }

      if (boat.dist <= 0.18) {
        boat.saved = true;
        savedCount++;
        if (savedCount >= goalCount) {
          onGoalMet();
        }
        continue;
      }

      // danger: if boat is within rock zone distance band and not lit enough
      if (dangerActive) {
        const dangerBand = boat.dist < 0.75 && boat.dist > 0.25;
        if (dangerBand && inRockZone(boat.angle) && boat.lit < 0.5) {
          boat.sunk = true;
          onStageFailed();
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- Drawing ----
  function drawBackground() {
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // subtle paper texture lines (cut layers)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.05;
    ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.accent;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, (H / 6) * i);
      ctx.lineTo(W, (H / 6) * i + 20);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawSea() {
    const R = Math.min(W, H) * 0.42;
    drawPaperShadow(() => {
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.highlight;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(center.x, center.y, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    });
  }

  function drawRocks() {
    const R = Math.min(W, H) * 0.42;
    for (let i = 0; i < rocksAngle.length; i++) {
      const r = rocksAngle[i];
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(center.x, center.y);
      ctx.rotate(r.center);
      drawPaperShadow(() => {
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
        ctx.beginPath();
        const rockDist = R * 0.72;
        const pts = jitteredPoly("rock" + i, [
          [rockDist - 14, -16],
          [rockDist + 14, -10],
          [rockDist + 18, 8],
          [rockDist - 6, 18],
          [rockDist - 20, 2]
        ], 2);
        ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
        for (let k = 1; k < pts.length; k++) ctx.lineTo(pts[k][0], pts[k][1]);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
      });
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawPort() {
    drawPaperShadow(() => {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#c9b183";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(center.x, center.y, towerRadius * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    });
  }

  function drawTower() {
    drawPaperShadow(() => {
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.layer;
      roundRectPath(center.x - towerRadius * 0.35, center.y - towerRadius, towerRadius * 0.7, towerRadius * 2, 10);
      ctx.fill();
    });
    // lamp housing
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(center.x, center.y);
    ctx.rotate(beamAngle);
    drawPaperShadow(() => {
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
      roundRectPath(0, -12, 34, 24, 8);
      ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBeam() {
    const R = Math.min(W, H) * 0.48;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(center.x, center.y);
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 5, 0, 0, R);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(244,236,216,0.65)");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(244,236,216,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.arc(0, 0, R, beamAngle - beamHalfWidth, beamAngle + beamHalfWidth);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBoat(boat) {
    const R = Math.min(W, H) * 0.42;
    const dist = 30 + boat.dist * (R - 30);
    const x = center.x + Math.cos(boat.angle) * dist;
    const y = center.y + Math.sin(boat.angle) * dist + Math.sin(boat.wobble) * 2;
    const lit = isLit(boat);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(boat.angle + Math.PI / 2);
    drawPaperShadow(() => {
      ctx.fillStyle = lit ? COLORS.highlight : COLORS.accent;
      ctx.beginPath();
      const pts = jitteredPoly("boat" + boats.indexOf(boat), [
        [0, -12],
        [8, 6],
        [0, 10],
        [-8, 6]
      ], 1.5);
      ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
      for (let k = 1; k < pts.length; k++) ctx.lineTo(pts[k][0], pts[k][1]);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.restore();

    // lit progress ring
    if (lit && !boat.saved) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.layer;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      const frac = Math.min(1, boat.lit / boat.needLit);
      ctx.arc(x, y, 16, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + frac * Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawBoats() {
    for (const boat of boats) {
      if (boat.saved || boat.sunk) continue;
      drawBoat(boat);
    }
  }

  function drawCard(text, subtext, y) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = "bold 26px sans-serif";
    const w = Math.max(260, ctx.measureText(text).width + 60);
    const h = subtext ? 110 : 70;
    const x = center.x - w / 2;
    const yy = y - h / 2;
    drawPaperShadow(() => {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fffaf0";
      roundRectPath(x, yy, w, h, 14);
      ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(text, center.x, yy + (subtext ? 38 : h / 2));
    if (subtext) {
      ctx.font = "16px sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(subtext, center.x, yy + 78);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = "bold 18px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillText("Phare " + stage + "  •  Sauvés: " + savedCount + "/" + goalCount, 16, 16);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function render() {
    towerRadius = Math.min(W, H) * 0.09;
    drawBackground();
    drawSea();
    drawRocks();
    drawBeam();
    drawBoats();
    drawTower();
    drawPort();

    if (screenState === "title") {
      drawCard("Le Gardien du Phare", "Touchez et glissez pour tourner le faisceau", center.y);
    } else if (screenState === "grace" || screenState === "playing") {
      drawHUD();
      if (stageMessageTimer > 0) {
        drawCard(stageMessage, null, 90);
      }
      if (screenState === "grace") {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.font = "bold 16px sans-serif";
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.fillText("Préparez-vous...", center.x, H - 40);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    } else if (screenState === "stagewin") {
      drawHUD();
      drawCard("Phare " + stage + " terminé !", "Prochain phare...", center.y);
    } else if (screenState === "win") {
      drawCard("Toutes les nuits sont sauves !", "Vous avez gagné", center.y);
    } else if (screenState === "lose") {
      drawCard("Un bateau a heurté les rochers...", "Nuit perdue", center.y);
    }

    if (paused && (screenState === "grace" || screenState === "playing")) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(61,64,91,0.4)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.restore();
      drawCard("Pause", null, center.y);
    }
  }

  // ---- Main loop ----
  let lastTime = null;
  function frame(ts) {
    if (lastTime === null) lastTime = ts;
    let dt = (ts - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = ts;
    if (dt > 0.1) dt = 0.1;

    update(dt);
    render();

    if (!booted) {
      booted = true;
      CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title: "Le Gardien du Phare", gameType: "stage-clear", lang: "fr" });
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  center.x = window.innerWidth / 2;
  center.y = window.innerHeight / 2;
  targetAngle = 0;
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
